exposure: Fetal heart rate abnormalities during ECV
cohort: 980 women (> 34 weeks gestation) with a singleton fetus in breech presentation
finding: Fetal heart rate abnormalities during and after external cephalic version were more frequent with lower estimated fetal weight and longer duration of the procedure, but did not predict mode of delivery or fetal distress during labor.
mod_finding: FHR abnormalities during and after ECV were not associated with the mode of delivery.
